warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.intro: Before hitting for real, get your body and rhythm ready.
steps: Mobility: a few smooth swings to loosen your shoulders and hips.
Start short: wedges, half swings, and some chips and pitches.
Build up gradually to full swings and the driver.
Practice with intention: one focus at a time, your routine before each shot.
Quality over quantity: a few good shots beat many rushed ones.
Once you're loose, you're ready for your coach's exercises.
